original_test_intent: Qualified physical inspection that every recipe component is correctly seated and retained.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Inspect complete recipe population, capture photos/blackbox status and platform evidence.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator performs direct visual/tactile inspection; agent only organizes evidence.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Complete physical seating intent and 5/5-minute references.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: SUT BOM/checklist, access/ESD procedure and photo/blackbox definition.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Software inventory cannot replace physical seating coverage.

original_method: Direct item-level inspection; do not clear logs or silently reseat parts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an approved digital checklist/photo manifest only as evidence support.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Internal access and subjective fit need a qualified operator.

no_automatic_retry: Stop on damage or ambiguity; repair/reseat needs approval.
review_improvement: No change: V3 already preserves the irreplaceable physical acceptance boundary.
